title: Morning Brief
intro_md: Type "more on G3" (or any code) here, or tap More info on the brief page and paste the request here, and I'll dig in.

items.headline_md: **Israel** votes today in a Knesset election, with Netanyahu's Likud facing Eisenkot's Yashar and Bennett's Together
items.summary_md: More than 7.3 million people can vote for the 120-seat Knesset. Polls are open 7 AM to 10 PM local time (10 PM Mon to 1 PM Tue AZ), and 37 lists are running.

items.headline_md: **Netanyahu** reportedly pushed for a strike on Iran before the vote, and IDF chief Zamir resisted
items.summary_md: Netanyahu denies the report. A UN commission separately accuses Israel of continuing genocidal acts in Gaza.

items.headline_md: Update: **Oleshky ceasefire** (Ukraine) is now in effect for aid and evacuations, brokered by Melania Trump
items.summary_md: It took effect at 01:00 GMT Tuesday, which was 6 PM AZ Monday.

items.headline_md: Update: **Brazil**: the Supreme Court orders Flávio Bolsonaro to hand in his passports, and Trump calls the vote "rigged"
items.summary_md: Trump also offered $1 million for tips on voter fraud.

items.headline_md: **Türkiye, Saudi Arabia, Pakistan and Iran** hold a four-way security meeting in Tehran
items.summary_md: Attendees include Türkiye's Ibrahim Kalin, Saudi Arabia's Khalid bin Salman and Pakistan's Asim Munir.

items.headline_md: **Finland and Norway**: the two leaders called Putin to try to restart peace talks
items.summary_md: Euronews also reports that a tornado in **Antalya, Turkey** killed at least four workers.

items.headline_md: **France** protests go on after 1,435 arrests on Saturday, with a nationwide protest called for Nov 5
items.summary_md: Reported in 10 Things' global roundup.

items.headline_md: **Japan**: former Prime Minister Yasuo Fukuda has died at 90
items.summary_md: China's fifth plenum, focused on party discipline, is also under way and runs for four days.

items.headline_md: **DoorDash** is in advanced talks to buy **Instacart** (Maplebear) at a valuation of about $17 billion
items.summary_md: WSJ reported it in Stocks to Watch at 4:50 AM AZ.

items.headline_md: **Microsoft** offers voluntary buyouts to about 60,000 employees, roughly 27% of its workforce
items.summary_md: It covers level 70 and below in the US, Canada, UK and India. Employees decide by early December and would leave Dec 31. Reports say Xbox staff are eligible too.

items.headline_md: **Broadcom** lines up $63 billion in financing tied to supplying **Anthropic**
items.summary_md: Lenders are BofA, Citi, Morgan Stanley and Blackstone, and the stock was up 2% before the open.

items.headline_md: **HSBC** falls 6.5% in London on a revenue miss, despite announcing a $1 billion buyback
items.summary_md: **Novartis** raised its profit outlook the same morning.

items.headline_md: **Porsche** plans to cut 25% of its workforce by 2035, and **Mercedes** lowers its margin outlook to 2–3%
items.summary_md: Porsche's operating profit for the first nine months was €1.74 billion.

items.headline_md: **Singapore and Aramco** agree to store crude in the Jurong Rock Caverns starting in 2027
items.summary_md: EU gas prices rose 3.3% to more than €97/MWh, the highest since December 2022.

items.headline_md: **Rotate Rings** by Hungry Studio is a new hybrid-casual hit, fully ad-monetized with about 350K installs a day
items.summary_md: It's score-based with no fail state. Gamigion also spots **Easybrain**'s *Color Away* (a Tap Away-style puzzle) and two **iKame** tile-puzzle tests.

items.headline_md: **Supercell** has completed its acquisition of **Metacore**, taking over Merge Mansion
items.summary_md: Listed in Gamigion's weekly mobile roundup, along with Mika Games' $10M fund.

items.headline_md: **Pokémon UNITE** shuts down on Switch and mobile on March 23, 2027
items.summary_md: Gem sales stopped today. A Nov 12 update adds a farewell event and a library feature that keeps your items.

items.headline_md: **Capcom** first-half operating profit rises 54.5% to ¥60.8B, and **Resident Evil Requiem** passes 8 million
items.summary_md: Pragmata is above 2.7M and Onimusha: Way of the Sword above 1.7M.

items.headline_md: **Sucker Punch** (Ghost of Yōtei) lays off 24 people, at least 10% of the studio
items.summary_md: The cuts follow the well-received Echoes of Sekigahara expansion.

items.headline_md: **Call of Duty** has passed $40B in lifetime revenue, but Activision is quiet on **Modern Warfare 4** launch sales
items.summary_md: Microsoft reports earnings Oct 28.

sections.title: Video Game Emulation
sections.body_md: No PS5 or Switch 2 breakthroughs today. **Wii U lifter**: still no public repo. I only found per-game Wii U recomps (Wind Waker HD, NSMBU, BotW CafeRecomp) and early frameworks (nWiiURecomp, DolRecomp). **Kirikae** is still on v0.1.2, **flossbud WWHDRecomp** has no release, **AnyPS5** is still on v0.1.3 (progress page: 48.86% of system-library functions, 100% of shader instructions), and **KytyPS5** only had nightlies. r/decomps was blocked (429), so this list comes from GitHub and recomp trackers.

items.headline_md: Update: **LASRecomp** (Link's Awakening, Switch to PC) Beta 5.3 fixes setup and holds 60 FPS on Steam Deck
items.summary_md: Published 12:06 PM AZ Mon. It detects damaged game files, setup no longer stops at 10% with Control Flow Guard on, and BowWow and randomizer bugs are fixed. It is still not declared stable.

items.headline_md: **NSMBU Recomp** v0.7.0 runs New Super Mario Bros. U (Wii U) natively on Windows, macOS and Linux
items.summary_md: Released 2:21 PM AZ Mon. The installer builds the game from your own copy (US/EU 1.3.0), and the download includes no game files or keys.

items.headline_md: **Panzer Dragoon Saga** gets a PC 'recomp' from the Yaba Sanshiro dev, but it's built on emulation
items.summary_md: It adds HD widescreen, removes slowdown and fixes wobbly polygons, and it needs your own disc image. Commenters say it is really an SH-2 emulator, while yaz0r is working on a true decomp.

items.headline_md: **ps3recomp** v0.18.0, a PS3 static recompilation runtime, adds D3D12 and Metal pipeline caching and better SPU support
items.summary_md: Released Oct 26, with broad RSX, Vulkan and HLE updates.

items.headline_md: **Army of Two Recomp** reaches 1.4 (Released), and **PS2RC** v0.2.0 and **Open Nectar** 1.1 (Pikmin) also shipped
items.summary_md: Listed on Recomp Haven's release tracker. I have not checked their changelogs.

sections.title: Movies
sections.body_md: Monday grosses aren't out yet (Box Office Mojo data as of 2:45 AM AZ). I found no Rotten Tomatoes scores or tracking for this weekend's releases.

items.headline_md: **You Can See Everything** beat **Clayface** on Sunday, $6.41M to $5.60M
items.summary_md: Sunday's top-10 total was $25.4M, down 22.1% from Saturday.

items.headline_md: **Halloween weekend** (Halloween is Saturday): no big studio openers, and Liam Neeson's **The Mongoose** goes out through Samuel Goldwyn
items.summary_md: The Numbers lists no tracking. Everest: The Other Side, Christmas at the Kringles and The Only Living Pickpocket in New York also open.

items.headline_md: **Call of Duty** movie: Peter Berg says it's about "the cost of war," not comic-book heroes
items.summary_md: Taylor Sheridan wrote it for Paramount, and it's dated June 30, 2028.

items.headline_md: **Keanu Reeves** replaces Alan Ritchson in Netflix's hurricane action film **Maelstrom**
items.summary_md: Jaume Collet-Serra directs, and it's the first project under Jeff Robinov's Netflix deal.

items.headline_md: **Lionsgate** forms a joint venture with **Steven Paul**'s SP Media, with an initial investment of about $100M
items.summary_md: It comes after reports that Legendary revived its bid for Lionsgate.

items.headline_md: **OpenAI** launches **GPT-6.1 Terra**, a faster computer-use model at half the API price
items.summary_md: $1/$5 per million input/output tokens, available in ChatGPT Work, Codex and the API. OpenAI says it hits its Critical cybersecurity threshold.

items.headline_md: **Google** adds **Gemini 4 Argon** to the Gemini app's model picker for Pro and Ultra subscribers
items.summary_md: Argon has been in the API since Oct 13.

items.headline_md: **Scale AI** faces noyb privacy complaints alleging its Outlier platform tracks 900,000 workers
items.summary_md: Reported by Euronews.

items.headline_md: **Apple App Store** review delays: some developers report waits of three weeks or more, plus stalled enrollments
items.summary_md: Apple's target is 90% of apps reviewed within 48 hours. Apple has not commented.

items.headline_md: **Google Play** Contacts policy: from Jan 27, 2027, apps must use the Contact Picker or justify READ_CONTACTS
items.summary_md: It applies to apps targeting Android 17.

items.headline_md: **Apple ads** get a boost from F1 sponsorships on Apple TV, while AdExchanger looks at why WebKit is blocking ID vendors
items.summary_md: New research on extended identifiers and ad-borne exploits helps explain it.

items.headline_md: **Acer Predator Atlas 8** handheld comes to the US Nov 1 for $1,299.99, only at Best Buy
items.summary_md: Windows 11, an 8-inch 120Hz screen and an 80Wh battery.

items.headline_md: **iPad mini** with OLED is expected this week, according to 9to5Mac
items.summary_md: Apple hasn't announced it.

sections.title: Markets
sections.body_md: The Fed's two-day meeting starts today, with the decision Wednesday.

items.summary_md: Reported in CNBC's live coverage.

items.headline_md: **Premarket movers** (4:55 AM AZ): **UPS** +1% after a beat and a higher guide, **JetBlue** +11%, **Whirlpool** −7% on a surprise loss, **Boeing** about +1%
items.summary_md: Whirlpool cut its full-year revenue guidance to $14.5B.

items.headline_md: **Celestica** +17% premarket after Q3 revenue rose 83% to $5.83B and it guided 2027 revenue to $40B
items.summary_md: Adjusted EPS was $3.30 against $2.96 expected.

items.headline_md: **Asia/Europe**: Nikkei +1.73%, Kospi +3.09%, CSI 300 −1.32%, Stoxx 600 −0.35%
items.summary_md: SoftBank rose 7.6% and SK Hynix 7.1% on reports of a special dividend. China's September industrial profits rose 14.4%.

items.headline_md: **Oil** about 1% lower: WTI near $101 and Brent near $114 (4:55 AM AZ)
items.summary_md: EU gas is at its highest since December 2022 (see B6).

items.headline_md: **Gold** $4,009.32, −0.36% (4:48 AM AZ), with the dollar near a two-week high
items.summary_md: CNBC earlier had spot −0.5% at $3,995.89.

items.headline_md: **Crypto**: Bitcoin $79,746 (−0.65% in 24h) and Ether $2,310.05 (−0.82%) at 5:09 AM AZ
items.summary_md: Bitcoin slipped below $80K.

items.headline_md: **Phoenix**: sunny, high near 86, tonight mostly clear with a low around 60, 0% rain
items.summary_md: No alerts. Light SE wind, 0–5 mph.

items.headline_md: **Show Low**: sunny, high near 66, low around 42 (38 overnight), 0% rain
items.summary_md: No alerts. S wind 6–15 mph with gusts to 22.

items.headline_md: **Snowflake**: sunny, high near 70, low around 41 (38 overnight), 0% rain
items.summary_md: No alerts. S wind 3–15 mph with gusts to 23.

items.headline_md: **Anthropic** files for a Nasdaq IPO under "ANT". CNBC's live coverage digs into the S-1: "900% revenue retention, but $80 billion in first-half losses"
items.summary_md: It's the first full look at a frontier AI lab's books: revenue growth, compute commitments over $475B, and dual-class control.
